english:
Light Weapon Kills grant 20% Grenade Ability Energy. Kinetic or Dark Weapon Kills grant 20% Melee Ability Energy.

Alternating between Light and Dark Weapon Kills within 10 seconds grants Resist x3 for 5 seconds, providing <pve 40% /> <pvp [7.5%] /> Damage Resistance. Refreshable by retriggering the effect.

Destroying destructible objects or Constructs can also trigger both effects.

source.text:
4 Piece | So Very Thin

Light Weapon Kills grant 20% Grenade Energy.
Kinetic/Dark Weapon Kills grant 20% Melee Energy.

Upon scoring a Light Weapon Kill within 10 seconds of scoring a Dark Weapon Kill, or vice versa:
Resist x3 (40% [7.5%] DR) for 5 seconds.
Refreshable by retriggering the effect.

Both effects can be triggered by destroying "destroyable entities" as well as Constructs.
